info.title: API.SH: Domclick
info.description: The Domclick API from API.SH: public Domclick data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Domclick listing: price, price per m², commission, deposit, full price history, Domclick's market price estimate (range, monthly and daily rent), recently sold flats nearby with prices, total, living, kitchen and room areas, rooms, floor, renovation, description, address with its district and street, coordinates, building facts (year, floors, ceiling height, walls, lifts, infrastructure, parking, security) and the house register record, residential complex, legal details (type of sale, number of owners, years owned, minors, occupancy), registry check, mortgage discounts, seller type and the agent's and agency's names (private owners with the first name the site shows and its verification marks, never a phone), dates, views, favourites and all photos, plus `raw`. Listings of every region work; pass the listing link, or the number with its deal_type and offer_type.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/domclick-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing number or a domclick.ru/card/... link (any regional subdomain); or use latest.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: the newest listing of a search (region default Moscow; any search parameter may be added) instead of id.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: With latest: the region to take the newest listing from.

parameters.name: deal_type
parameters.description: With a bare number: sale (default) or rent.

parameters.name: offer_type
parameters.description: With a bare number: the property type (default flat).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Property listings on Domclick (Russia) for sale or for rent in a region, city or district: flats, rooms, new-build layouts, houses, house parts, townhouses, land and commercial property, with the site's filters (rooms, price, area, kitchen area, floor, building floors, price per m², minutes on foot to the metro, apartments only, with photos, owners only, wall type) and sorts. Each item has id, link, deal and property type, price, price per m², monthly mortgage payment, discount, area, rooms, floor, building floors and year, address, region, coordinates, metro stations, residential complex, description, dates, seller type, the agent's or agency's name (private owners with the first name the site shows and its verification marks, never a phone), registry check, up to 8 photos and the photo count, plus `raw`. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/domclick-search

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: City, region or district name (e.g. Москва, Казань) or its aid number from /domclick/v1/suggest.

parameters.name: offer_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated property types (default flat): flat, layout (new-build), room, house, house_part, townhouse, lot, office, trade_area, catering, free_purpose, warehouse, manufacturing, hotel, commercial_land, garage, box, parking_place. Commercial types search commercial property.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum price in roubles (monthly rent for rentals).

parameters.name: metro_walk_minutes_max
parameters.description: Maximum minutes on foot to the metro.

parameters.name: wall_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: brick, monolith, panel, block, wood, brick_monolith.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), price, published, area or price_per_m2.

parameters.name: sort_dir
parameters.description: asc or desc (default: asc for price sorts, desc otherwise).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
